name: French Guiana
prevalence_note: No Guiana-specific official scam bulletin was located; French national cyber-assistance guidance on fake parcel and delivery messages is the main applicable reference.
cross_border_note: French Guiana (+594) borders Brazil and Suriname, so residents may also get calls or messages from +55 and +597 numbers alongside mainland French (+33) ones.

scams.name: Faux message La Poste ou transporteur
scams.name_en: Fake La Poste or courier parcel message in French Guiana asking for a fee or secret code
scams.signals_en: A message impersonating La Poste or a courier claims an undelivered parcel and requests a small payment or a confirmation code.
scams.legit_en: French national guidance says delivery firms never ask for bank codes by message; check only on the carrier's own site.
bait_tactics: Demander de quel bureau de Cayenne ou de Kourou vient l'avis
Dire que la carte bancaire est restée chez soi et demander de rappeler plus tard
